text:
maria: quick heads-up — link-scan-bot just flagged a few broken links in the runtime onboarding runbook :grimacing:
link-scan-bot: automated scan completed — 3 broken links in `docs/runtime/onboarding/*` (172.16.4.2)
maria: i can open a tiny PR but i don't want to guess ownership. who keeps runtime-onboarding these days? @toshi? :eyes:
toshi: yep i've been the informal owner, happy to take these. can you paste the paths so i don't have to re-run the scan?
maria: sure — bot printed the files but here's a quick grep i ran locally: ```
# find local dead links
rg "https?://(internal|staging)" docs/runtime/onboarding -n || true
``` 
maria: the three hits: `docs/runtime/onboarding/quickstart.md:45`, `docs/runtime/onboarding/troubleshooting.md:88`, `docs/runtime/onboarding/images.md:12`
alex: thanks — FYI the first one points at an internal shortlink that was rotated. i'll check if it's in CODEOWNERS; if not we should add a line so future small fixes get auto-assigned
sam: if it's a shortlink we can just replace with canonical URL in the small PR, no need for content review. +1 for a tiny PR from maria with me as reviewer
ellen: heads-up about images.md — some images were rehosted last month to the assets CDN and path changed. recommend copying current image path to the PR rather than rehosting again
maria: ok plan: i'll open a single PR with three tiny edits: replace shortlink with canonical, update image path, and fix the trailing slash in troubleshooting link
maria: tagging reviewers: @sam + @ellen. toshi — want to be assignee or should i just ping you after PR?
toshi: put me as assignee, i'll do a quick smoke test after merge and run the link-scan job again
alex: if you want to update CODEOWNERS for `docs/runtime/onboarding/*`, open a separate PR and ping infra docs. not required for this tiny fix
maria: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/pulls/4212 — very small, two lines per file. reviewers requested: sam, ellen
sam: reviewing now, will leave tiny nits inline. :thumbsup:
ellen: LGTM pending image path check. if you want i can rehost the image under the same cdn prefix and include a redirect, but that can be follow-up
link-scan-bot: re-scan scheduled in 10m; if PR merges before then it will clear on the next scan
maria: thanks team — appreciate the quick dibs. will merge once sam approves and toshi confirms post-merge smoke test
